glosses: Something that protrudes, sticks out, or sticks together; a cluster or blob; a mound or mass of no particular shape.

examples.text: a lump of coal; a lump of clay; a lump of cheese

glosses: A swelling or nodule of tissue under the skin or in an internal part of the body.

examples.text: Lumps in the breasts are an indicator of breast cancer.

glosses: To treat as a single unit; to group together in a casual or chaotic manner (as if forming an ill-defined lump of the items).

examples.text: People tend to lump turtles and tortoises together, when in fact they are different creatures.

glosses: To bear (a heavy or awkward burden); to carry (something unwieldy) from one place to another.

examples.text: Well, a male body was brought to a certain surgeon by a man he had often employed, and the pair lumped it down on the dissecting table, and then the vendor received his money and went.
